title: `blob` contents
description: The base64 `blob` form of resource contents, used for anything that is not text.
question: Can the agent read a binary resource without corrupting it?
notes: A binary resource survives the round trip through both adapters that reach 2026-07-28; 3 cannot reach the revision.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI 1.15.1 requires MCP Python SDK 1.26.x, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.2: LangChain MCP Adapters 0.3.2 requires mcp<2.0.0, so it cannot open a 2026-07-28 adapter session.
notes_by_num.3: Mastra 1.17.3 negotiated MCP 2025-11-25. The scanner refused to compare that capture with a 2026-07-28 source.

verdict.headline: Binary contents survive intact in both adapters that reach 2026-07-28.
verdict.detail: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.22.0 returns `BlobResourceContents` with the base64 payload untouched. Pydantic AI 2.40.0 decodes it into a `BinaryImage` whose bytes match the source PNG exactly. Neither corrupts the payload by treating it as text. CrewAI, LangChain and Mastra cannot negotiate MCP 2026-07-28, so they reach none of it.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Text and binary contents are different fields, not different encodings of one field. A framework that assumes `text` either drops binary resources or turns them into mojibake, and both failures look like a successful read.
